title: Voglio e non vorrei. No. vorrei e non.
html_source:
Bloom misquotes and then corrects the duet from Don Giovanni that Molly is preparing for her recital. Translated into English, this would runL “I want to and would not like to. No. I would like to and would not like to.”

That is to say: should I or shouldn’t I?
